title: Donald Trump Jr criticizes Netflix over racy 'Hunting Wives' Thanksgiving post
summary: Donald Trump Jr. called out Netflix after the streamer posted a steamy "The Hunting Wives" clip on Thanksgiving, asking "What is wrong with you???"

title: US pilot tells Trump which fighter jet is ‘world’s greatest’ during Thanksgiving phone call
summary: An F-16 pilot told President Donald Trump the jet is the "world's greatest" during a Thanksgiving call, saying "you couldn't pay me to switch airplanes."

title: Trump takes on Somali welfare dependency in Thanksgiving message, lays out who should stay in US
summary: President Donald Trump says only 2% of Minnesota's Somali community should stay, claiming on Truth Social the rest should be thrown out to save the state.

title: Trump, NATO chief push Russia to avoid any actions that would 'expand the war' with Ukraine
summary: President Donald Trump and NATO chief Mark Rutte, who met Wednesday night at Mar-a-Lago, urged Russia to avoid actions that might expand the Ukraine war.

title: A look at how the Trumps spend their Thanksgiving holiday through the years
summary: Donald Trump marks his sixth Thanksgiving as president with the White House turkey pardon, after past holidays at Mar-a-Lago and Bagram Airfield.

title: Trump country cracked: 5 races that saw double-digit Trump territory fall to Democrats in 2026
summary: Donald Trump carried Mississippi by nearly 23 points, yet Scott Colom beat Cindy Hyde-Smith by less than one, ending a 44-year GOP Senate drought.

title: 2nd Circuit deals blow to Manhattan DA, breathes new life into Trump's hush money appeal
summary: President Donald Trump's bid to move his New York hush money case to federal court is revived after the 2nd Circuit cited errors in a prior denial.

title: Trump's birthright citizenship restrictions struck down again by DC federal judge he called 'hater'
summary: Judge Christopher Cooper struck down Trump's second birthright citizenship order, citing the Fourteenth Amendment and rejecting surrogacy-based exclusions.

title: It turns out Florida Gators coach Jon Sumrall is just as superstitious as his fanbase
summary: Jon Sumrall made a last-minute switch away from the Florida Gators' blue helmets before the rivalry game with Florida State, and the gambit paid off.

title: Aaron Rodgers claims he was barred from Steelers facility before infamous interview in message to Al Michaels
summary: Al Michaels said Aaron Rodgers told him Mike McCarthy never called and that he was barred from the Pittsburgh Steelers facility, prompting his rant on "The Pat McAfee Show."
